summary: Nodes s2 (temple.html, source/live) and s3 (focus.html, source/live) emit THREE independent --grn signals simultaneously: (1) orbital canvas dot via TYPE_COLOR.source='#00ff88' at L347, (2) stream sidebar si-dot via TYPE_COLOR.source at L459, (3) si-state.live text via .si-state.live{color:var(--grn)} at L67. Three green signals on non-admitted objects = strongest false-admission reading in the graph. E76 (TYPE_COLOR.source) and E74 (.si-state.live) each address one layer; only their joint application eliminates all three. Hex alternative '#aaaaaa' avoids this — no ')' in hex, transform no-ops safely, pull-rings render at full gray.
